messages:
olivia_sdr: HarborTech wants a Private POC proving BYOK + CloudHSM non-exportability, CSR signing pipeline, and automated cert rotation for inference nodes. Need coordinator for a 2-week window starting next Mon.

sam_se: I'll draft quote/SOW. Are we doing Redwood-managed certs or customer CA + HSM?

ravi_eng: Recommend customer CMK (BYOK) plus short-lived node certs. Two demo patterns: (1) node CSR -> customer CA webhook signs; (2) Vault PKI backed by CloudHSM. Both keep private keys in HSM.

jules_security: For the SQ we'll need HSM attestation, CMK ARN, key policy preventing export, audit log retention >=90d, mTLS for control plane. Also need SSH bootstrap policy.

marta_ops: Ops: cert formats (PEM for gRPC; PKCS12/JKS for Java). Rotation agent runs as systemd timer and renews before expiry. If Vault, auth via AppRole or IAM in their VPC/private link.

ravi_eng: Quick examples:
```
openssl req -new -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout node.key -out node.csr -subj "/CN=inference-node-01/O=HarborTech"
```
Vault role:
```
vault write pki_int/roles/inference_node allowed_domains="inference.harbor.local" ttl=24h
```

olivia_sdr: They insist keys must never leave HSM. Pattern 1 fine if they host signing endpoint or sign manually for verification.

jules_security: We'll request attestation report and sample KMS key policy; prepare minimal NDA addendum for attestation artifacts.

sam_se: Draft quote: 2 small GPU nodes for 2 weeks + 8 eng hours. Sending draft to Olivia.

deploy-bot: checklist created: https://intranet.redwood/poctools/1893456000 items: CMK ARN, HSM report, CSR endpoint, node image

olivia_sdr: Actions:
- sam_se: send quote + SOW (EOD)
- ravi_eng + marta_ops: prepare two config examples (webhook + Vault) + rotation demo (tomorrow)
- jules_security: SQ artifact list (EOD)
- HarborTech contact: elena@harbortech.com (need CMK ARN & HSM attestation)

ravi_eng: Recommend OOB manual sign test: we generate CSR, they sign offline to validate chain before automating.

olivia_sdr: Kicking off Mon 10am PT. I'll post replies here. :thumbsup:
